methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a local native represent grassroots knowledge distribution beyond traditional tech hubs, testing whether peer-to-peer learning can spread AI fluency in military-adjacent metros without requiring elite institutional infrastructure.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's formalized partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates educational resources and innovation capacity in the state capital, potentially deepening Richmond's AI capabilities while the model's transferability to rural regions remains untested.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A liberal arts college launching a WorkAI Lab signals knowledge infrastructure emerging outside metro corridors, testing whether distributed institutions can build practical AI fluency or if geographic distance from tech centers limits depth.

signals.title: From AI cameras to drones, Fairfax Co. uses new technology in policing - WTOP
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County's deployment of AI cameras and drones demonstrates advanced implementation capacity concentrated in NoVA's well-resourced jurisdictions, widening the technological governance gap between metro hubs and resource-constrained localities.

signals.title: How AI is changing what happens to Hampton Roads' trash - The Suffolk News-Herald
signals.signal_reading: AI-powered waste management represents platform-delivered efficiency gains requiring operational adoption but not deep technical capability, signaling shallow-but-practical AI diffusion in infrastructure sectors across mid-tier metros.
